title: Providing More Help for Those Undergoing In-vitro Fertilisation
what_it_is: Providing More Help for Those Undergoing In-vitro Fertilisation

sections.label: Personal IVF journey
sections.summary: The speaker describes a journey of pain, anguish, excitement, disappointment, hope and happiness, and having a child only at the seventh IVF attempt.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: It was a journey filled with pain and anguish, excitement and disappointment, and hope and happiness at times.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: We were only able to have a child at our seventh IVF attempt.

sections.label: IVF and conception statistics
sections.summary: KK Women's and Children's Hospital says 15% of couples cannot conceive within 12 months, and assisted reproduction procedures rose over 40% from 2013 to 2017.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: KK Women's and Children's Hospital says 15% of couples are unable to conceive within 12 months of trying for a baby.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: There were over 7,700 assisted reproduction procedures carried out in 2017, up from about 5,500 in 2013 – a 40% increase in just four years.

sections.label: IVF success rate
sections.summary: For most couples IVF involves trying again because only about 18% of attempts succeed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: For most couples, IVF is a story of trying and trying again because only about 18% of attempts succeed.

sections.label: Removing IVF cycle quota
sections.summary: The third proposal is to remove the quota on fresh and frozen cycles for subsidised IVF treatment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: My third proposal is to remove the quota on fresh and frozen cycles for subsidised IVF treatment.

sections.label: Dropping IVF subsidy quota
sections.summary: The speaker proposes dropping the three-fresh, three-frozen quota for IVF subsidies, saying more flexibility might reduce stress and anxiety and raise success rates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Giving couples more flexibility might help reduce the stress and anxiety these couples face and lowering their stress and anxiety levels might help increase their success rate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I propose we drop the three-fresh, three-frozen quota for IVF subsidies.

sections.label: Fertility leave proposal
sections.summary: The speaker says many Singaporeans depend on employers' goodwill on making a baby and proposes allowing husbands and wives several days of fertility leave per year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: So, the reality is that even on the sacred topic of making a baby, many Singaporeans are dependent on the goodwill of their employers, and this is not right.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I propose that we allow husbands and wives to take several days of fertility leave per year.

sections.label: IVF subsidy and fertility leave proposals
sections.summary: The speaker proposes raising subsidised IVF cycles to eight, subsidising PGD, removing the fresh and frozen quota, and introducing fertility leave.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In summary, my proposals are, one, increase the number of subsidised IVF cycles from six to eight; two, introduce subsidies for PGD; three, remove the three-fresh, three-frozen quota for IVF subsidies; and, four, introduce fertility leave for all employees.

sections.label: More money for parenthood
sections.summary: The speaker asks the Government to spend more despite tight budgets, saying a chance to become a parent is priceless.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: We must do everything we can to open the gates to those who come knocking.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I know I am asking for the Government to give out more money, increase our expenditure at a time when our budgets are tight.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: But what we are offering fellow Singaporeans is a chance to become a parent and that is truly priceless.

sections.label: Speaker outnumbered by daughters
sections.summary: The speaker says he is outnumbered by a queen and three princesses and hopes more is done so couples can enjoy parenthood.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I am terribly outnumbered with a queen and three princesses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: But, Sir, I know what others are going through and I hope we do more for them so that more couples can enjoy the gift of parenthood.

sections.label: 2013 co-funding quantum raised
sections.summary: In 2013 co-funding for SC-SC couples at public AR centres rose from 50% for up to three fresh cycles to 75%.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: In 2013, the co-funding quantum for SC-SC couples at our public AR centres was raised from 50% for up to three fresh cycles with a cap of $3,000 per cycle to 75% with a cap of $6,300 per cycle to help defray further costs.

sections.label: 2018 co-funding caps increased
sections.summary: In April 2018 the co-funding cap per fresh cycle rose from $6,300 to $7,700 and per frozen cycle from $1,200 to $2,200.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: In April 2018, the co-funding cap per fresh cycle was further increased from $6,300 to $7,700 while the cap per frozen cycle was increased from $1,200 to $2,200.

sections.label: MediSave withdrawal for assisted conception
sections.summary: Patients may withdraw up to a $15,000 lifetime limit from their own or their husband's MediSave Account for assisted conception procedures.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: Patients can withdraw up to a lifetime limit of $15,000 from their own or their husband's MediSave Account to pay for assisted conception procedures, or ACPs, which include ART and IUI.

sections.label: Success rates by women's age
sections.summary: Success rates fall with age: 26.6% below 30, 24.6% at 30 to 34, 17.1% at 35 to 39, and 6.7% at 40 and above.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: Success rates are 26.6% for women below 30, 24.6% for women from 30 to 34, 17.1% for women from 35 to 39, and 6.7% for women 40 and above.

sections.label: Mainstreaming PGD and subsidies
sections.summary: MOH is working to mainstream PGD as a clinical service and is studying subsidy cost-effectiveness and allowing MediSave payment.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: MOH is working to mainstream PGD as a clinical service for couples who need it and is studying whether it is cost-effective to be eligible for subsidies.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: We will also look at the proposal to allow PGD to be paid using MediSave.

sections.label: Co-funding cycle limits
sections.summary: Co-funding can be extended to a maximum of six cycles, with up to three fresh cycles co-funded to the cap.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: Basically, this means that co-funding can be extended to a maximum of six cycles, with a maximum of three cycles co-funded up to the cap for fresh cycles.

sections.label: Employer sensitivity and fertility leave
sections.summary: Employers are encouraged to be sensitive to couples' needs, while any fertility leave enhancement must balance employee needs and employers' operational constraints.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: We encourage employers to be sensitive to the needs of couples who may need to make use of these existing provisions.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: I am sympathetic to calls for more gender-neutral leave but I also recognise that any enhancement to leave provisions for fertility must strike a balance between meeting the needs of employees and employers' operational constraints.

sections.label: No new clinical evidence yet
sections.summary: The review was seven years ago, no information can be released now, and there is no new clinical evidence on the number of cycles.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: Again, as I have shared, it was seven years ago that we reviewed it.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We do not have the information that can be released at this juncture.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We will update, as and when an outcome arises from review.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In respect to the number of cycles, as I explained, the basis on which the number of cycles for which subsidies and co-funding are given is pegged to clinical evidence.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: At this juncture, there is no new clinical evidence.
